decisions.model: parking/station-level direct tariff through Telpark app
decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: 109 locations, 861 EVSE, 861 connectors. Telpark officially exposes charging through its app and currently applies conditional percentage discounts rather than publishing one network-wide base price.
decisions.blockingReason: Base charging price is parking/station dependent; a network-wide tariff would be an extrapolation.
decisions.resumeCondition: Enumerate exact app/parking prices after first pass or map deterministic REVE connector tariffs.

decisions.blockingReason: No official/public direct numeric charging tariff authority located in the first-pass search.
decisions.resumeCondition: Official dealer/site/QR/app tariff or deterministic REVE tariff mapping.

decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: 1 location, 1 EVSE, 4 connectors. MedPlaya officially confirms EV charging at Hotel Bali but does not publish a numeric charging tariff.
decisions.blockingReason: Charging availability is official, price is not publicly deterministic.
decisions.resumeCondition: Official hotel/QR/app numeric tariff or deterministic REVE tariff mapping.

decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: 120 locations, 252 EVSE, 252 connectors. Moeve officially states one ultra-fast charging tariff of 0.60 EUR/kWh across its own network.
decisions.resumeCondition: Revalidate if Moeve publishes a tariff change; keep interoperable eMSP partner pricing separate from direct Moeve CPO pricing.

decisions.blockingReason: No official numeric public charging tariff found; company registry/retail information does not establish a customer charging price.

decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: 1 location, 12 EVSE, 12 connectors. Official registry confirms operation of EV charging points; third-party station data currently shows numeric AC/DC prices but is not promoted as tariff authority.
decisions.blockingReason: Numeric tariff found only through non-authoritative station data in this pass.
decisions.resumeCondition: Official station/QR/app price or deterministic REVE connector-tariff mapping.

decisions.resumeCondition: Enumerate app prices after first pass or map deterministic REVE connector tariffs.
